explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/694: Carmichael asked whether some n has exactly one solution m of φ(m)=n. The statement ∃ n > 0, ∃! m, φ(m) = n poses that question; n = 0 is excluded because only φ(0) = 0 in Lean. The question is open; Carmichael's totient conjecture expects the answer no. The statement takes the positive form under a question tag, the usual convention when no answer(...) is used. Faithful.
